rationale: The morning auction resolved bearishly — the stock opened at 13.65 (its high) and faded to the lows on heavy volume, leaving price pinned at 13.55, below session VWAP (13.60) and the 5m 9-EMA — but the current tape is dead: the last four 1-minute bars traded under 3,000 shares each with a one-cent range, meaning neither downside continuation nor a VWAP reclaim has a trigger right now. Entering short here risks chasing a move that has already stalled at 13.54 support with no selling pressure behind it, and entering long means buying weakness below VWAP against a mildly risk-off tape (SPY -0.32%, VIXY +1.16%) with no news catalyst. With 240 minutes left in midday chop and a coin-flip risk/reward in both directions, the mechanical edge is absent; I'd reconsider on a volume-backed break of 13.54 (short) or a reclaim of 13.60 VWAP (long).
